youtube.title: Sikkon ke kinare ridges kyun hote hain? 🪙 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Kisi sikke ke kinare par ungli ghumao, toh chhoti chhoti lakeerein mehsoos hongi. Kabhi sikke asli sone aur chandi ke bante the, aur chor unke kinare se patli parat chheel kar dhaatu bech dete the.

Phir wo chhota hua sikka poori keemat par chala dete the. Lakeeron se ye chheelna turant pakda jaane laga. Aaj ye nabeena logon ko sikke pehchanne mein bhi madad karti hain.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
